verdict.rationale: The core product is an open-source CLI (vercel-labs/skills) that runs entirely locally via `npx`, reading skills from your own GitHub repos (public or private, using existing repo auth) with no vendor server or account required to operate — confirmed by a keyless runtime probe showing it works with zero login. This makes the core functionality inherently self-hostable/self-run without any Vercel-hosted backend. Missing for 10: no explicit self-hosting docs for the skills.sh leaderboard site itself, and no stated license terms confirming redistribution/self-hosting rights beyond the public GitHub repo.
